title: TABLE 1: FACTORY HUMVEE VARIANTS
intro: For the original M998 and M998A1 series, separate ‘M’ numbers were assigned to winch-equipped vehicles; this practice was discontinued when the A2 series was introduced in 1995 leading to some simplification of the range of variants, although the numbering sequence remains confused.
footnotes: * The M996 and M996A1 ambulances were specified, but never actually put into series production.
** Designated XM1109 UA-HHV (up-armoured heavy Humvee) during development.

title: TABLE 8: DIMENSIONS AND WEIGHT
intro: All variants share the following dimensions: overall width, 85in (2,159mm) or 91in (2,311mm) (M1100 series reliability-enhanced vehicles); wheelbase, 130in (3,302mm); front and rear track, 72in (1,829mm).
footnotes: * The M996 and M996A1 ambulances were specified, but never actually put into series production.

** Addition of 'B' armour kit increases kerb weight as follows (and, in order to stay within the design gross vehicle weight, reduces payload accordingly): M1151A1 (B1 kit), 2,150lb (977kg); M1152A1 (B2 kit), 1,660lb (754kg); M1165 (B3 kit), 2,640lb (1,200kg).
